channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Sites oficiais do Senado e da Alerj registram pós-graduação que Flávio Bolsonaro não fez
item.description: Official websites of the Brazilian Federal Senate and the Rio de Janeiro State Legislative Assembly (Alerj) incorrectly state that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential candidate, holds a postgraduate degree in 'political sciences'. The Alerj biography claims he studied at UFRJ, but no evidence confirms completion. The false information was identified on December 8, 2026.

item.title: Iniciativa popular quer 50% das vagas no Legislativo para mulheres
item.description: A popular initiative proposed by the São Paulo Public Prosecutor's Office and organizations such as Vote Nelas and Black Women Decide seeks to reserve 50% of seats in Brazilian legislative bodies for women, with 25% of that quota allocated to Black women. The movement aims to collect 1.7 million signatures to file a complementary law in the National Congress, arguing that women make up 51.5% of the population but hold only 17% of legislative seats, and that current gender quotas for candidacies are insufficient to achieve equality.

item.title: Câmara instala comissão para debater PEC da redução da maioridade; votação será depois das eleições
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies has installed a special committee to analyze a constitutional amendment (PEC) that would lower the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 years, with voting scheduled after the October elections. The proposal, led by rapporteur Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) and committee president Aluisio Mendes (Republicanos-MA), amends Article 228 of the Constitution to make individuals aged 16 and older criminally liable as adults. The debate centers on whether the change violates constitutional 'cláusulas pétreas' and international treaties, requiring 308 votes in two rounds for passage in the plenary.

item.title: Campanhas de Lula e Caiado divergem sobre regulação da IA
item.description: Representatives from Lula's (PT) and Caiado's (PSD) campaigns debated AI regulation and technology policies at Casa JOTA in Brasília. Bimbo (PT) supported the Redata regime as a fiscal incentive for data centers, while Rocha Lima (PSD) criticized the current proposal and advocated for a broader tax regime that does not tax capital expenditures (Capex), citing biogas from Goiás as a sustainable energy alternative for data centers.

item.title: Plano de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe quarentena de 1 ano para indicação ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government plan proposes a one-year quarantine for former ministers and state secretaries before they can be nominated to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), aiming to block immediate appointments like those of Jorge Messias and Flávio Dino by President Lula. The measure would also affect past nominations by Jair Bolsonaro, such as André Mendonça. Flávio states that any government starting in 2027 will need to reform the Judiciary, suggesting the possibility of fixed terms for STF justices.

item.title: Crusoé: Quanto Janja custou até agora no governo Lula
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva's government-related expenses exceeded R$ 117.5 million in 2024, according to the 'Janjômetro' platform created by São Paulo state deputy Guto Zacarias (União Brasil) to track public spending by her office. The figure marks an 86% increase from the previously reported R$ 63 million.

item.title: Lula assina decretos sobre descarbonização e transição energética
item.description: President Lula signed four decrees to accelerate decarbonization and energy transition in Brazil, including rules for carbon capture and storage, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), and opening the free energy market for low-voltage consumers. The measure will allow small businesses, industries, rural properties, hospitals, and schools to freely choose their electricity provider starting November 2027, with residential consumers gaining access in November 2028, with expectations of lower electricity prices. The decrees also establish a national infrastructure plan for carbon and regulate the National Low-Carbon Hydrogen Policy.

item.title: O silêncio sobre o indicado de Lula para o STF na reunião com Alcolumbre
item.description: In the second meeting between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, the name of Jorge Messias — Lula’s pick for the STF and the focal point of their recent conflict — was not mentioned. Messias remains Lula’s chosen nominee for the Supreme Court vacancy, despite being rejected by the Senate in April. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Alcolumbre elogia conversa com Lula e diz que tratou de ‘relação institucional do futuro’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre praised his meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the Palácio da Alvorada, stating they discussed the 'institutional relationship of the future' and that dialogue between the branches of government had been restored after three months of estrangement. Despite the positive tone, Alcolumbre reiterated there is no set date for voting on the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, despite government pressure to approve it before the elections.

item.title: MG: patrimônio de Marcelo Aro quase dobra em quatro anos
item.description: Senate candidate Marcelo Aro (PP) declared a 97.9% increase in assets between 2022 and 2026, rising from R$4.8 million to R$9.5 million, according to his TSE filing. The growth is largely driven by loan-related credits (R$5.5 million), a category already significant in 2022. He is the second wealthiest among the four Senate candidates registered in Minas Gerais, behind Carlos Viana (PSD).

item.title: Reaproximação de Lula e Alcolumbre vai até a página dois
item.description: Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre resumed dialogue in a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, eight days after a prior encounter at Justice Alexandre de Moraes’ residence. While institutional relations have been restored, lingering grievances remain: Lula resents the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias, and Alcolumbre feels underappreciated by the Planalto. The government relies on Alcolumbre’s support to advance key agendas, including the MP ending the ‘shirt tax’ (expiring September 8), the Public Security PEC, and the 6×1 workweek reform, though Alcolumbre remains cautious and selective in his cooperation.

item.title: 'Diálogo restabelecido', diz Alcolumbre sobre reunião com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated that institutional dialogue with President Lula has been restored after two productive meetings, including a two-hour session this Wednesday. They discussed key government agendas such as the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale, the Public Security PEC, the MP that abolished the 'shirt tax', and proposals on critical minerals and rare earths. Alcolumbre also confirmed he will be on Lula’s ticket in the 2026 elections in Amapá, as stated by Minister José Guimarães.

item.title: Campanha de Tarcísio vê deboche de Haddad com concurseiros e pretende explorar tema
item.description: Allies of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) plan to use in the 2026 campaign a remark made by Fernando Haddad (PT) during the Band debate, in which he called Tarcísio a 'concurseiro' (career civil servant), aiming to undermine his image and question his readiness for executive office. The strategy seeks to exploit the perceived mocking tone in Haddad’s comment to mobilize Tarcísio’s base and reinforce narratives of the PT candidate’s unpreparedness. The note was published on 08/12/2026 at 16:32.

item.title: Lula começa a campanha como favorito
item.description: President Lula begins his 2026 re-election campaign as the frontrunner, according to polls showing his stability and advantage over opponents, particularly Flavio, who is described as inconsistent. His incumbent status provides structural advantages, making it difficult to defeat a sitting president. The article is noted as exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Contenção de despesas e incentivos fiscais: entenda projeto sobre combustíveis
item.description: The complementary bill (PLP) initially proposed by Lula's government to fund fuel tax exemptions through extraordinary oil revenues amid the Iran war was adapted by Congress to accommodate various interests, including ethanol sector incentives introduced by rapporteur Marussa Boldrin (Republicanos-GO). The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Como Marco Rubio, crítico de Lula, insufla a escalada entre EUA e Brasil
item.description: Marco Rubio, U.S. Secretary of State and national security advisor, has become a key interlocutor in U.S.-Brazil relations under the Trump administration, exerting pressure on Lula’s government despite efforts for direct dialogue between the presidents. His approach reflects a hardline stance against leftist regimes in Latin America, exemplified by his defense of the U.S.-led capture of Nicolás Maduro in Venezuela, which he frames as an anti-narcotics operation. The growing rift between Washington and Brasília stems from divergent strategies, with Rubio advocating a more confrontational line than Trump’s openness to direct engagement.

item.title: Caiado diz que buscará outro nome com o mesmo perfil de Gakiya para ministro da Segurança Pública
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, presidential candidate for the PSD, said he will seek another candidate with the same profile as prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya to lead the Ministry of Public Security after Gakiya declined due to his current duties. Caiado respected the decision and reiterated that the desired profile includes experience in combating organized crime, as demonstrated by Gakiya in São Paulo’s Gaeco. He unveiled a security plan that includes classifying criminal factions as domestic terrorist organizations, lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for specific crimes, and building 40 maximum-security prisons.

item.title: Moraes arquiva investigação contra Hang por atos antidemocráticos
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes dismissed an investigation against businessman Luciano Hang over alleged support for anti-democratic acts following the 2022 elections, after the Federal Police and the Attorney General’s Office found no evidence that Hang or Havan representatives authorized or encouraged the blockade of BR-470 in Rio do Sul (SC). The ruling was issued last Thursday (August 6), with a note that the case may be reopened if new evidence emerges.

item.title: Arena Cross Brasil disputa Super Final em Interlagos
item.description: The Arena Cross Brasil Super Final will take place on August 14-15 at Interlagos, featuring two full race days with full championship points awarded each day. The PRO category is tied between Brazilian Enzo Lopes and Scottish Dean Wilson, both at 97 points, making the double-header decisive for the title. The international field includes riders from the USA, UK, France, Spain, Portugal, and Argentina, highlighted by five-time AMA Arenacross champion Kyle Peters and Paulo Alberto, the most successful rider in Arena Cross Brazil history.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio admite 'erro' em currículo de senador que citava especialização em universidade federal
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign admitted that official profiles contained inaccurate academic information, including a claimed postgraduate degree in Political Sciences from UFRJ, which the university denies ever recording. The team states his correct education is a law degree from Universidade Cândido Mendes, a postgraduate in Public Policies from Iuperj, and an MBA in Entrepreneurship from FGV, and that they have requested corrections on platforms where the errors appeared.

item.title: Crusoé: Quem convenceu Michelle a gravar um vídeo com Flávio Bolsonaro?
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro convinced his wife, Michelle Bolsonaro, to record a video supporting their son Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate in 2026, to ease tensions between them and strengthen the family's political campaign.

item.title: PSD do Paraná pede indeferimento de candidatura de Moro por falta de plano de governo
item.description: The Paraná PSD has asked the TRE-PR to reject Sergio Moro's (PL) gubernatorial candidacy for failing to submit a government plan with his TSE registration, claiming it constitutes an essential document omission that grants him an illegal competitive advantage. Moro argues that Brazilian law allows candidates to supplement documentation, including the government plan, until August 15, and that late submission does not constitute omission. If the request is granted, Moro will have 72 hours to submit his plan or risk having his candidacy rejected.

item.title: Congresso adia instalação de comissão que analisa MP que acabou com taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The installation of the joint committee tasked with analyzing the measure that repealed the 'blusinhas tax' was postponed due to a lack of agreement among congressional leaders over the committee's presidency and rapporteurship. Senator Randolfe Rodrigues suspended the meeting and rescheduled it for 6:30 p.m. today, with a possible further delay to Thursday if no consensus is reached. The measure must be approved by September 8 to prevent the reinstatement of a 20% tax on international purchases, a move the government seeks to avoid during an election year.

item.title: Flávio construiu a trajetória “em cima da certidão de nascimento”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), stating that his political trajectory was built 'on the birth certificate,' referring to the surname inherited from Jair Bolsonaro. The remark was made in the context of criticizing the lack of experience among opponents in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Câmara instala comissão sobre redução da maioridade penal e dá seguimento a proposta que pode reduzir idade mínima
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies installed a special committee to discuss reducing the age of criminal responsibility, with Aluísio Mendes (Republicanos-MA) as president and Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) as rapporteur. Despite formal installation, voting will be delayed until after the elections, with public hearings planned for September and committee analysis expected to conclude between November and December.

item.title: Brasil ordena a Discord suspender los directos tras el suicidio de una adolescente de 13 años
item.description: Brazil ordered Discord to suspend its live streaming features after a 13-year-old girl died by suicide following a live session on the platform where she was induced to self-harm. First Lady Janja Lula da Silva called for the platform’s blockade during an official event with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, after five minors and one adult were arrested for aggravated homicide linked to the incident. The case, which occurred in Naviraí, Mato Grosso do Sul, also involved encouragement to torture and kill a cat.

item.title: Congresso adia instalação da comissão para analisar MP da 'Taxa das Blusinhas'
item.description: Congress postponed the installation of the mixed committee to analyze the provisional measure revoking the 'blusinhas tax', which would eliminate the 20% import tax on international purchases up to US$50. The MP, issued by Lula's government on May 12, expires on September 8 if not approved, reinstating the tax from September 9. The delay follows a rift and reconciliation between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and is seen as a political gesture in an election year.

item.title: Pesquisa para governador de SP atualizada: veja o último levantamento
item.description: The Ideia/ACSP poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) leading Fernando Haddad (PT) in the race for São Paulo governor in the 2026 elections. The survey, released last Monday (10), is the latest on the state race and indicates an advantage for the incumbent governor over the former president.

item.title: Saga da botina: Paula provoca e Celina manda sapato para a adversária
item.description: Governor Celina Leão (PP) sent a boot to deputy Paula Belmonte (PSDB) in response to a debate provocation, after Belmonte accused her of playing the victim regarding the BRB. Belmonte received the gift but reiterated her demand for the 2025 BRB balance sheet, which remains unpublished. Leão stated she will release the balance after signing the R$6.6 billion loan with the FGC.

item.title: Cobertor curto: crédito de Lula seca fundos em dois meses
item.description: The Lula government is facing rapid depletion of public credit guarantee funds, such as the FGO and FGI, due to the accelerated expansion of loan programs like Pronampe, Procred 360, and Move Motoristas ahead of the 2026 elections. Resources initially projected to last 12–14 months are now expected to last only two to three months, prompting a request for an additional R$ 2.75 billion in funding to prevent the collapse of guarantee capacity. This reflects the indirect fiscal impact of election-driven credit expansion: while loans are repayable, they require public capital to absorb risk, and the waiver of fees in Move Motoristas intensifies the strain on these funds.

item.title: O dia em que Lula, Haddad e investigada por tráfico dividiram o mesmo palanque em SP
item.description: During a September electoral debate, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas accused Fernando Haddad of sharing a stage with Alessandra Moja, a drug trafficking suspect from Favela do Moinho, at a Lula government event. Haddad denied seeing the photo and claimed Freitas was lying, though the image exists in an official government broadcast showing Alessandra invited onstage alongside Lula, Haddad, and other ministers. The incident caused embarrassment, with Freitas alleging the federal government failed to screen individuals linked to organized crime.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro corrige informação sobre pós-graduação na UFRJ
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign corrected information published on the official Alerj and Senate websites claiming he had completed a postgraduate degree in Political Sciences at UFRJ. The university stated it has no records of his enrollment or graduation. The correction aims to prevent misinformation about his academic background.

item.title: Lula liga para líder do PT na Câmara após AVC, que segue 'consciente' e 'estável'
item.description: President Lula called Deputy Pedro Uczai (PT-SC), leader of the PT in the Chamber, who remains hospitalized after suffering an ischemic stroke in the left cerebellum during a Leaders' College meeting on Tuesday. Uczai is conscious, stable, and showing positive evolution, with no cognitive or motor impairment. Lula wished him a speedy recovery and emphasized that Uczai needs to be well to lead the caucus and support the PT's electoral campaign.

item.title: Governo e Congresso destravam pauta da ‘taxa das blusinhas’
item.description: Senate and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) met with President Lula (PT) and government representatives to discuss resuming dialogue on the legislative agenda after weeks of tension between the Executive and Legislative branches. The meeting focused on unblocking the agenda surrounding the so-called 'tax on little blouses,' a nickname for the proposal to tax low-value imports, particularly from Asian e-commerce platforms.

item.title: Plano de governo de Flávio prevê subsídio a idosos de menor renda
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will present his government plan on August 13, the same day he will officially register his presidential candidacy in the TSE system. Titled 'For Brazil to Overcome Backwardness,' the plan is organized into thematic pillars and includes a specific section for the elderly called 'Safe Home for Aging,' with proposals such as subsidies for low-income families to adapt homes for accessibility, expansion of long-term care institutions, and development of a companion and alert app for elderly individuals living alone.

item.title: Motta visita líder do PT no hospital após AVC durante reunião
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) visited PT leader Pedro Uczai (SC), who was hospitalized at DF Star after suffering a stroke during a leaders' meeting on Tuesday (11/8). Uczai's office reported he remains lucid, with no motor or cognitive sequelae and stable clinical condition. The meeting and deliberative session were canceled, and Uczai received a call from Lula and messages of support from fellow lawmakers.

item.title: Lula IV seria outro Lula?
item.description: A potential fourth Lula term would face a difficult fiscal adjustment period between 2027 and 2030, requiring politically costly measures such as restraining minimum wage growth, revising social benefits, and advancing administrative reform. While Lula might be convinced of the need for such adjustment by deteriorating economic conditions, his ability to implement it would depend on building a broad, heterogeneous congressional coalition — a challenge that historically leads to coordination problems and limits presidential agenda-setting, especially when ministerial appointments and resource distribution do not reflect parliamentary strength of allies.

item.title: Lula aparece com chapéu em imagem para urna; relembre fotos dele em eleições anteriores
item.description: Lula’s re-election campaign released the official photos for the electronic ballot box, featuring him wearing his signature Panama hat, a recurring element in his public image. His running mate, Geraldo Alckmin (PSB), was also included in the release. The imagery reinforces a familiar and symbolic visual identity aimed at connecting with voters.

item.title: Gestão Tarcísio aciona o STF e diz que governo Lula trava aval a empréstimo de R$ 5,4 bi para obras
item.description: São Paulo's government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, filed a petition with the STF to compel the Ministry of Finance to grant approval for a R$ 5.4 billion loan from Banco do Brasil to fund infrastructure and urban mobility projects. The state argues the federal government is unjustifiably delaying the authorization, despite the National Treasury having issued a favorable technical opinion in May, while other states like Bahia received approval in under 10 days. The petition requests the STF order the approval within 48 hours or that its interim decision serve as the required guarantee.

item.title: TSE inaugura Centro de Divulgação das Eleições 2026 na segunda-feira (17)
item.description: On Monday (17), the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) inaugurates the Election Disclosure Center 2026 in Brasília, launching the campaign 'Elections 2026 – A Matter of Skin,' inspired by Jorge Aragão’s samba. The center will support press coverage of the October general elections, with accreditation for the inauguration only available until Friday (14).

item.title: Kassab diz que Caiado cogita Armínio Fraga para o Ministério da Fazenda
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, the vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket, stated that Armínio Fraga, former president of the Central Bank, is being considered for the Ministry of Finance in a potential Caiado administration. The remark was made on Wednesday, the 12th, and underscores the economic coordination of the candidacy.

item.title: Para apoiar Simões em MG, União Progressista quer controle da Cemig
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) secured formal re-election support from the União Progressista federation in exchange for influence over key positions at Cemig, including its presidency. The alliance, formed after considering launching Marcelo Aro (PP) as an independent candidate, has fractured their prior relationship, with Aro now backing Simões’ rival Cleitinho (Republicanos). Simões’ running mate will be Danilo de Castro (União Brasil), father of federal deputy Rodrigo de Castro.

item.title: Adesivo eleitoral pode prejudicar cobertura do seguro automotivo
item.description: FenSeg warns that adorning vehicles with electoral stickers may be seen as increased risk by insurers due to higher exposure to accidents, vandalism, and public events. Failing to update insurance policies after such changes may result in denied claims for theft, robbery, or collision. Drivers are advised to consult their insurer, update the CRLV if fully wrapped, and check coverage for adhesive damage.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre alinham expectativas e devem ter novo encontro logo, diz ministro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre held a second meeting in a few days at the Palácio da Alvorada, aligning expectations and signaling a possible new encounter in the coming days. The meeting included Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães and Senate Government Leader Teresa Leitão, and was described as productive for restoring dialogue between the Executive and Legislative branches. Both emphasized their commitment to institutional strength and joint construction of national priorities.

item.title: Meta tem de informar quem pagou ataque a Tarcísio após expor operação de fake news
item.description: Meta delivered reports to São Paulo's Electoral Justice showing that false information against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas was amplified by accounts operated from abroad, though the accounts' registrations prevent identification of who paid for the content. The company was compelled to provide the data after exposure of a fake news operation. The case highlights challenges in tracing financiers of disinformation in electoral campaigns.

item.title: Lula pode usar chapéu em foto na urna? Entenda o precedente no TSE
item.description: President Lula submitted a photo wearing a hat to the TSE for use on the electronic ballot in 2026, following skin cancer treatment. The image complies with requirements for being recent, frontal, and with a uniform background. In 2022, the TSE allowed a candidate to wear a cap as part of his cultural identity, which may serve as a precedent for Lula, though the ruling was individual and does not broadly authorize accessories.

item.title: Haddad diz que escolha para Secretaria de Segurança será por "perfil"
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that if elected, he would choose the Secretary of Public Security based on 'profile' rather than career, seeking someone determined, fearless, and organized. He criticized current governor Tarcísio de Freitas for lack of transparency in fiscal incentives and outlined his security plan, including body cameras, reduced police lethality, and the creation of a State Anti-Faction Agency. Haddad also warned of the need to restructure state finances to comply with the Fiscal Responsibility Law by 2026.

item.title: Presente de Janja e aliados, recomendação médica e imagem renovada: como chapéu panamá deve virar uma das marcas de campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula has adopted the Panama hat as a campaign symbol following skin cancer treatment, using it to project a renewed and light image. The accessory, gifted by Janja and allies, appears in official events and campaign materials, gaining significant reach on social media. The strategy aims to rejuvenate the image of the 80-year-old candidate seeking a fourth term.

item.title: Crusoé: “STF e crime organizado não respeitam as leis”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, criticized Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' order for a search and seizure operation against Raimundo Soares Cutrim, former Maranhão state secretary, alleged to be an informant for journalist Luís Pablo. Santos claimed that both the STF and organized crime disregard the law, challenging the operation's legitimacy.

item.title: Candidata no Piauí, Lourdes Melo volta a viralizar: "Não vote em mim"
item.description: Piauí gubernatorial candidate Lourdes Melo of the PCO went viral after, during a live interview on TV Conecta, being told she could not ask for votes under TSE rules and replying: 'Then I say: don't vote for me'. She emphasized her work in strikes, women's rights, and labor movements, stating she can only ask people to get to know her, not vote for her. This is not her first controversy: in 2022, she accused debate moderators of censorship and called Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'judge with an egg head'.
